# Research Context

## Botanical archives as visual systems {.smaller}

- Botanical knowledge historically circulated through **image–text assemblages**
- Illustrations functioned as tools of:
  - taxonomy
  - classification
  - imperial knowledge-making
- European botanical illustration emphasised:
  - standardisation
  - morphological comparison
  - isolated specimens
- Parallel traditions also existed:
  - Chinese *Bencao*
  - Japanese illustrated herbals
  - medicinal manuscripts

::: {.notes}
Emphasise that this project is not only technical, but also historical and epistemological.
:::

---

# Project Aim

## What is *Phyto-Vision*?

Phyto-Vision is a reproducible computational workflow for:

- metadata normalisation
- archival deduplication
- automated botanical illustration extraction
- visual similarity analysis

## Goal

Transform heterogeneous digitised botanical pages into a structured, machine-readable visual corpus.

# Metadata and Deduplication

## Building interoperable archives

- Metadata schema adapted from the *ZuantuSet* workflow
- Descriptive fields normalised into machine-readable formats
- Duplicate editions identified through image collation techniques
- Supports:
  - longitudinal comparison
  - cross-cultural analysis
  - scalable archival integration

---

# Iconographic Extraction

## YOLOv11 object detection

- Seed corpus:
  - 781 manually annotated illustrations
- Sources included:
  - Library of Congress
  - Bibliothèque nationale de France
  - Royal Horticultural Society
  - National Archives of Japan
  - University of Tokyo Library

## Data augmentation

- horizontal flipping
- random cropping
- noise injection

Expanded training set:
**1,875 images**

# Model Performance

## Round 1 Training Results

- mAP@50: **96.9%**
- Precision: **95.5%**
- Recall: **90.3%**

## Iterative refinement

- Applied model to 391 additional pages
- Manual correction of predictions
- Added hard negative samples
- Expanded dataset to:
  - **2,815 images**

# Visual Embedding Analysis

## Beyond detection

After extraction:

- Illustrations converted into embeddings using:
  - **DINOv2 ViT-B/14**
- Similarity measured using:
  - cosine similarity
- Clustering performed with:
  - HDBSCAN

## Enables

- similarity retrieval
- visual grouping
- cross-cultural comparison
- unsupervised pattern discovery

## UMAP network of illustrations {.smaller}

```{=html}
<style>
  .reveal section:has(#umap-viz) > h2 {
    margin: 0 0 0.15em 0;
    font-size: 1.4em;
  }
  #umap-viz {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 720px;
    background: #0d1117;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: grab;
    user-select: none;
  }
  #umap-viz.dragging { cursor: grabbing; }
  #umap-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
  }
  #umap-error {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #f87171;
    font-size: 14px;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 20px;
  }
</style>

<div id="umap-viz">
  <canvas id="umap-canvas"></canvas>
  <div id="umap-error"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const container = document.getElementById('umap-viz');
  const canvas = document.getElementById('umap-canvas');
  const errorEl = document.getElementById('umap-error');
  if (!container || !canvas || container.dataset.bound) return;
  container.dataset.bound = '1';

  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let data = null;
  const thumbs = new Map();
  let camera = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, zoom: 1 };
  let dataBox = { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 1, y1: 1 };
  let scheduled = false;
  let initialised = false;

  function fitCameraToData() {
    camera.x = (dataBox.x0 + dataBox.x1) / 2;
    camera.y = (dataBox.y0 + dataBox.y1) / 2;
    camera.zoom = 1;
  }

  function requestDraw() {
    if (scheduled) return;
    scheduled = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { scheduled = false; draw(); });
  }

  function resize() {
    const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.width === 0 || r.height === 0) return;
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(r.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(r.height * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = r.width + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = r.height + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    if (data) fitCameraToData();
    requestDraw();
  }

  function worldToScreen(wx, wy, r) {
    const sx = (r.width  * camera.zoom) / Math.max(1e-6, dataBox.x1 - dataBox.x0);
    const sy = (r.height * camera.zoom) / Math.max(1e-6, dataBox.y1 - dataBox.y0);
    return [r.width  / 2 + (wx - camera.x) * sx,
            r.height / 2 + (wy - camera.y) * sy];
  }

  function draw() {
    if (!data) return;
    const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.width === 0 || r.height === 0) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1117';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, r.width, r.height);

    const dotR = Math.max(1.0, 1.4 * Math.sqrt(camera.zoom));
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
    for (let i = 0; i < data.nodes.length; i++) {
      const n = data.nodes[i];
      if (n.img && thumbs.has(i)) continue;
      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(n.x, n.y, r);
      if (sx < -4 || sx > r.width + 4 || sy < -4 || sy > r.height + 4) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = data.colors[n.c];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, dotR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    const thumbPx = Math.max(28, Math.min(110, 42 * Math.sqrt(camera.zoom)));
    for (const [i, img] of thumbs) {
      const n = data.nodes[i];
      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(n.x, n.y, r);
      if (sx < -thumbPx || sx > r.width + thumbPx ||
          sy < -thumbPx || sy > r.height + thumbPx) continue;
      const aspect = (img.naturalWidth && img.naturalHeight)
        ? img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight : 1;
      let w, h;
      if (aspect >= 1) { w = thumbPx; h = thumbPx / aspect; }
      else { h = thumbPx; w = thumbPx * aspect; }
      ctx.fillStyle = data.colors[n.c];
      ctx.fillRect(sx - w / 2 - 2, sy - h / 2 - 2, w + 4, h + 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.fillRect(sx - w / 2 - 1, sy - h / 2 - 1, w + 2, h + 2);
      try { ctx.drawImage(img, sx - w / 2, sy - h / 2, w, h); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  function bindInteractions() {
    let dragging = false, lastX = 0, lastY = 0;
    container.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      dragging = true; lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
      container.classList.add('dragging');
    });
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      dragging = false; container.classList.remove('dragging');
    });
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!dragging) return;
      const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      const sx = (r.width  * camera.zoom) / Math.max(1e-6, dataBox.x1 - dataBox.x0);
      const sy = (r.height * camera.zoom) / Math.max(1e-6, dataBox.y1 - dataBox.y0);
      camera.x -= (e.clientX - lastX) / sx;
      camera.y -= (e.clientY - lastY) / sy;
      lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
      requestDraw();
    });
    container.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const factor = Math.exp(-e.deltaY * 0.0015);
      const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mx = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width;
      const my = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
      const wx = camera.x + (mx - 0.5) / camera.zoom;
      const wy = camera.y + (my - 0.5) / camera.zoom;
      camera.zoom = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(80, camera.zoom * factor));
      camera.x = wx - (mx - 0.5) / camera.zoom;
      camera.y = wy - (my - 0.5) / camera.zoom;
      requestDraw();
    }, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  }

  async function init() {
    if (initialised) { resize(); return; }
    initialised = true;
    try {
      const res = await fetch('umap_data.json');
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
      data = await res.json();
    } catch (e) {
      errorEl.style.display = 'flex';
      errorEl.innerHTML =
        'Could not load umap_data.json &mdash; serve the slides via a ' +
        'local web server (e.g. <code>quarto preview</code>).';
      return;
    }

    let x0 = Infinity, y0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, y1 = -Infinity;
    for (const n of data.nodes) {
      if (n.x < x0) x0 = n.x;
      if (n.y < y0) y0 = n.y;
      if (n.x > x1) x1 = n.x;
      if (n.y > y1) y1 = n.y;
    }
    dataBox = { x0, y0, x1, y1 };
    fitCameraToData();

    resize();
    requestDraw();

    // Stream thumbnails from Azure (a few at a time to be friendly).
    const queue = [];
    data.nodes.forEach((n, i) => { if (n.img) queue.push([i, n.img]); });
    const MAX_PARALLEL = 8;
    let inflight = 0, cursor = 0;
    function pump() {
      while (inflight < MAX_PARALLEL && cursor < queue.length) {
        const [idx, url] = queue[cursor++];
        inflight++;
        const im = new Image();
        im.onload = () => { thumbs.set(idx, im); inflight--; requestDraw(); pump(); };
        im.onerror = () => { inflight--; pump(); };
        im.src = url;
      }
    }
    pump();

    bindInteractions();
  }

  // Defer init until the canvas is actually visible (reveal.js hides off-screen slides).
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.isIntersecting && e.intersectionRatio > 0) {
        init();
        io.disconnect();
        break;
      }
    }
  }, { threshold: 0.01 });
  io.observe(container);

  if (typeof Reveal !== 'undefined' && Reveal.on) {
    Reveal.on('slidechanged', () => setTimeout(() => { if (initialised) resize(); }, 40));
    Reveal.on('resize', () => { if (initialised) resize(); });
  }
})();
</script>
```

# Results and Interpretation

## What becomes possible?

Phyto-Vision enables large-scale analysis of:

- visual standardisation
- page composition
- illustration conventions
- cross-cultural botanical representation

## Key idea

Historical visual logics become computationally analysable.
